messages:
evan-partners: Quick sync 3: Solstice EAP access confirmed under NDA. They want a short, repeatable benchmark and a telemetry bundle limited to perf + thermals. Can we define the minimal fields and a dry-run date?
nora-solstice: Thanks Evan. We can host two racks week of 05/12. We need CSV export and a single summarized report (no raw hostnames). Also request that any public slides are pre-approved.
pat-eng: Proposed minimal telemetry: sample_ts, token_latency_ms, p95_latency_ms, gpu_temp_c, gpu_power_watts, mem_used_mb. No hostnames, replace host_id with anonymized tag (node-1, node-2). Sampling 2s.
lia-legal: Confirmed the substitution approach (node-x) is acceptable. NDA requires retention limits: telemetry retained for 45 days unless otherwise agreed. We'll need Solstice sign-off on retention and summary language.
kai-sre: Lab booking done by lab-bot: Week of 2026-05-12, RackA-2 and RackB-1 reserved. Dry-run suggested on 05/09 16:00 UTC so we can iterate.
qa-jen: For smoke checks I'll run the smoke set solstice-smoke-12 (12 prompts) and validate token-level outputs vs baseline. If mismatch > 0.5% we'll abort run.
pat-eng: Bench config (v1.0): model=redwood-large-4x, quant=8bit, seq=4096, batch=2, warmup=5, samples=25. We'll capture tail-latency at seq=4k with burst pattern (10 reqs over 30s).
nora-solstice: We'll provide KMS-encrypted S3 bucket for telemetry drops. Please ensure telemetry files are encrypted client-side with our public key and we rotate upload tokens every day.
evan-partners: Action items: 1) pat to post bench config + run command, 2) lia to draft retention + embargo clause for Solstice sign-off, 3) qa-jen to schedule dry-run validation checklist, 4) kai to confirm rack IP access window.
pat-eng: Run command snippet:
```
./bench_runner \\
  --model redwood-large-4x \\
  --quant 8bit \\
  --seq 4096 \\
  --batch 2 \\
  --warmup 5 \\
  --iters 25 \\
  --telemetry /out/solstice/telemetry_$(date +%s).jsonl \\
  --telemetry-sample-sec 2 \\
  --anonymize-hosts true
```
(we'll post actual script in the drive).
kai-sre: Note on infra: for long seqs please ensure shm limits are bumped and nvme swap disabled. I'll push a node image with our tuned kernel.
qa-jen: I'll bring a small eval harness to run after each full iteration and log diffs to the summary file. Also will run a small token-level correctness script: `python3 check_tokens.py --baseline s3://redwood/baselines/rl4x/baseline_v3.json`
lia-legal: I'll draft a one-paragraph embargo + retention note and loop Solstice legal. ETA EOD tomorrow.
lab-bot: Lab reservation confirmed: 2026-05-12 to 2026-05-14, RackA-2,RackB-1. Access window 08:00-20:00 UTC daily.
evan-partners: Looks good. Please flag any compliance hiccups early. We'll aim to produce an embargoed summary for Solstice review within 48h of run completion. If anything blocks dry-run, ping here. :raised_hands:
